summary: Barbados's foreign ministry visa list says nationals of the USA and Canadians can stay for a maximum of six months. The EU–Barbados agreement provides visa-free travel for EU citizens for a maximum of three months during a six-month period. The Immigration Department says travellers are required to complete the online Immigration and Customs Form, available 72 hours before arrival, and to present the receipts on arrival.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Barbados?
faq.answer: The UK government says British citizens do not need a visa to visit Barbados. Barbados's foreign ministry visa list says no visa is required for Canadians, and that nationals of the USA and Canadians can stay for a maximum of six months; the EU–Barbados agreement provides visa-free travel for EU citizens for a maximum of three months during a six-month period. If your nationality needs a visa, the Immigration Department says you should first apply and be granted permission to travel to Barbados before booking and confirming travel.

faq.question: Do I need to fill in the Barbados travel form?
faq.answer: Yes. The Immigration Department says travellers must complete the online Immigration and Customs Form, available 72 hours before arrival, and present the receipts on arrival.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Barbados?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. Barbados's foreign ministry visa list says nationals of the USA and Canadians can stay for a maximum of six months, and the EU–Barbados agreement provides visa-free travel for EU citizens for a maximum of three months during a six-month period. The UK government says British visitors will be told how long they can stay when they arrive. The Immigration Department says permission to enter is granted only by the Immigration Officer at the port of entry, and that persons wanting a longer period than the time granted can apply to the Immigration Department at its Headquarters; it lists a $100.00 application fee.

faq.question: Can I work remotely from Barbados?
faq.answer: Yes. Barbados's tourism site says the Barbados Welcome Stamp establishes a visa to allow people to work remotely in Barbados for a maximum of 12 months. It lists fees of USD 2,000 for an individual and USD 3,000 for a family bundle, and says applicants must make an annual income of at least USD 50,000 over the 12 months they intend to have the stamp.

faq.question: Can I use US dollars in Barbados?
faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says you can easily exchange US dollars and euros for the Barbadian dollar in banks and currency exchange bureaus, and that you should carry cash as some smaller businesses only accept cash.

entryRequirements.declarations.online-tr.text: Travellers are required to complete the online Immigration and Customs Form which will be available 72 hours prior to your arrival in Barbados.
Once the form is completed, the Immigration and Customs receipts are to be saved to your mobile device or printed and presented to Immigration and Customs upon arrival.

countryFacts.bestTimeToVisit.text: The rainy season extends from June to November.
The hurricane season is from early June to the end of November in the Atlantic, Caribbean Sea and Gulf of Mexico.

countryFacts.driving.text: 1 . Convention on Road Traffic Geneva, 19 September 1949

A visitor or temporary resident of Barbados may obtain a temporary driving permit by applying to The Licensing Authority offices at The Pine, St. Michael, Oistins in Christ Church and Holetown in St. James at any approved hired car agency. The applicant must be in possession of a valid driving license issued by the traffic authorities in his/her country of normal residence. There is a fee for the permit, which will be valid for one year or until the expiry of the applicants driving license, whichever is the shorter time.
If you are a visitor to Barbados, then you are legally required to apply for a visitor permit before driving on our public roads.
